name: Dark Luxury
oneLiner: Black tie on screen: deep charcoal, thin gold hairlines, a high-contrast serif, and restraint used as a status signal.

effects.noise: 1.5% film grain over hero imagery only
effects.gold-hairline: 1px solid rgba(200, 169, 106, 0.45) used as a section divider, 24px inset

motion.reducedMotion: cross-fade only; no reveals that translate content

primary.base: height: 52px; padding: 0 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(200, 169, 106, 0.6); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-accent); font-family: Jost, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase
primary.hover: background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent)

filled.base: height: 52px; padding: 0 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: Jost, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: padding: 40px 32px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 0
default.media: aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover; filter: saturate(0.85) contrast(1.05)

default.base: font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.2vw, 4.25rem); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: 0.01em
default.kicker: display: block; margin-bottom: 16px; font-family: Jost, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-accent)

default.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none

height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 0 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: Jost, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em
default.focus-visible: border-bottom-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--uiux-color-accent)
default.label: display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

do: Keep surfaces black and near-black; the luxury comes from spacing and one gold hairline, not shine.
Set headlines in a light high-contrast serif and labels in a wide-tracked uppercase sans.
Use square corners and generous vertical rhythm (72–112px section spacing).
Photograph or treat imagery low-saturation so the gold accent is the only warmth.
dont: Do not use gradients, glows, or gold foil textures on interface chrome.
Do not round corners or add pill-shaped buttons.
Do not set body copy below 15px or letter-space whole paragraphs.
Do not mix gold with a second metallic hue.
antiPatterns: Black background plus gold gradient text plus a serif — the three-signal cliché that reads as a casino.
Shrinking body copy to 13px light weight on black to look exclusive; it just reads as unreadable.
Gold borders on every card, every input, and every divider, so nothing is emphasised.

notes: Light-weight serif at large sizes is fine, but light sans body copy on black drops below comfortable contrast; use weight 400 at minimum for paragraphs.
Gold hairlines are decorative; never use 1px gold alone to indicate focus or state.
Large display type with wide tracking needs explicit line-height to avoid overlapping accents in some languages.
